reviewNote: The «Filters» button (top left) › «Support» tab shows the three products. «A year without ads» is a non-renewing subscription: ads stop for one year from purchase and it never renews by itself; the app computes the end date from the signed StoreKit transaction. «No ads, forever» is a one-time non-consumable. «Buy me a coffee» is a consumable tip that unlocks nothing, as the app says next to it. «Restore purchases» is on the same screen.
